name: Storm Burst of Repulsion Totems
summary: Storm Burst of Repulsion on Spell Totem: the totems channel orbs that bounce away from the target and detonate when the channel ends, so the damage keeps landing while you walk. The Hierophant totem and mana package pays for the channel, and no unique is required.

pros.text: Totems channel the orbs while you move, so uptime survives mechanics.
Physical-to-lightning conversion scales with the same spell gear as any caster.
The bouncing orbs cover a pack without precise aiming.
Hierophant mana recovery keeps two channelling totems affordable.
No required unique; gem levels and a rare sceptre carry the build.
The same sceptre and spirit shield serve any later lightning spell.

cons.text: Totem uptime is a second thing to manage on top of the channel.
Single-target needs both totems alive through the whole fight.
The orbs travel, so a mobile boss can walk out of the damage.
Mana is tight before the Hierophant recovery package is online.
Area damage kills totems in dense rare packs.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.

swaps.note: After the campaign, transform a Storm Burst at the Divine Font in the Merciless Labyrinth or buy the gem in trade.

summary.text: Storm Burst of Repulsion Totems measure 30.1k at red maps and 46.6k at pinnacle. Two Spell Totems channel the bouncing orbs while you position, and the build needs no unique.

leveling.text: Rolling Magma carries the campaign. Storm Burst of Repulsion is transfigured, so it only arrives from the Divine Font in the Merciless Labyrinth or from trade after the campaign. The first checkpoint measures 377 life and 49 damage; the second measures 285.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 30.1k damage, 23309 effective life and 9308 physical max hit. Keep both totems down, recast them ahead of the pack, and let the orbs finish the clear.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 46.6k damage with 32807 effective life and 11231 physical max hit. Place both totems before the burst window and refresh them after every immunity phase.
